answer: In the EigenTrust matrix, reputation is propagated through reciprocity-weighted trust links and decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so durable influence requires sustained honest service rather than a burst of activity. Freshly spawned sybil identities have almost no trusted incoming paths and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; without reciprocal evidence, they cannot meet consensus thresholds. A whisper of collusion cannot revive a relic of stale trust or lift it to the zenith.
